title: Chitra Genius Self-Growth: Sesi, Feedback Koreksi, dan Memory Learn API & UI
description: Implementasi endpoint RAG Self-Growth (GET /api/v1/rag/sessions, GET /api/v1/rag/sessions/{id}/messages, POST /api/v1/rag/feedback, POST /api/v1/rag/memory/learn, GET /api/v1/rag/memory/facts) dan integrasi frontend UI (Tab Riwayat & Memori Pintar, tombol feedback/koreksi bubble chat, form ajari AI fakta baru).
completionDetails: Implementasi lengkap fitur Chitra Genius Self-Growth: Sesi, Feedback Koreksi Jawaban, Memory Learn API (/api/v1/rag/*) dan UI Tab Riwayat & Memori Pintar
